title: 未年のひつじのシルエット
lead: 歩く・跳ぶ・休むなど、羊の姿をひとつの色で表したシルエット6点です。年賀状の図案、ロゴ、飾りに使えます。
subject_en: sheep silhouettes, each ONE sheep centred in its cell, fully readable shape with wool texture shown by the outline only. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a sheep jumping with all legs lifted
a sheep lying down with legs folded
a small lamb standing, side view
a sheep and a lamb standing close together
